system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Model this mission for a robotic sensing and estimation system named MapRigLocalizeB: Estimate pose, velocity, and relevant sensor biases while following a bounded route. The physical system is as follows. A 22 kg mobile base carries a 20 m planar lidar, forward RGB-D camera, wheel encoders, and IMU at explicitly different rates and transforms. Bounded wheel drives follow the mapping route and the allowed command magnitude is 9.84 N.m-per-wheel. Provide fixed landmarks or external references without giving ground truth to the estimator. Instrument the scenario as follows: Preserve every sensor rate, timestamp, frame, standard deviation, and bias state. Control it using an extended or invariant Kalman filter with asynchronous updates. During the middle third, inject a controlled 0.028 sensor-bias step disturbance. Run at 100 Hz for 10 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Require finite positive covariance, position and attitude error bands, bias convergence, and actuator limits, primary tracking error below 0.24 m-or-rad after 6.5 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
